The second sentence describes who did not receive the unsend, with a variable for the names of people who did not receive the retraction message. MESSAGE_RETRACTED_BY_ME_WITH_N_UNSUPPORT.Comment: Text shown when an unsent message partially failed to unsend, and we know that some recipients cannot receive the unsend. The second sentence describes who did not receive the unsend, with a variable for the names of people who did not receive the retraction message. The third sentence is a variable MESSAGE_RETRACTED_BY_ME_WITH_UNSUPPORTED_RECIPIENTS_AND_RETRACTION_FAILED_STATUS_ERROR_SUBSTRING explaining that an error occurred during the unsend.

MESSAGE_RETRACTED_BY_ME_WITH_N_UNSUPPORT.Comment: Text shown when an unsent message partially failed to unsend, and we know that some recipients cannot receive the unsend. The second sentence describes who did not receive the unsend, with a variable for the names of people who did not receive the retraction message. The third sentence is a variable MESSAGE_RETRACTED_BY_ME_WITH_UNSUPPORTED_RECIPIENTS_AND_RETRACTION_FAILED_STATUS_ERROR_SUBSTRING explaining that an error occurred during the unsend.

MESSAGE_RETRACTED_BY_ME_WITH_N_UNSUPPORT.Comment: Text shown when an unsent message partially failed to unsend, and we know that some recipients cannot receive the unsend. The second sentence describes who did not receive the unsend, with a variable for the names of people who did not receive the retraction message. The third sentence is a variable MESSAGE_RETRACTED_BY_ME_WITH_UNSUPPORTED_RECIPIENTS_AND_RETRACTION_FAILED_STATUS_ERROR_SUBSTRING explaining that an error occurred during the unsend.
